protocol: STRICT rolling origin: forecast of transition t->t+1 uses snapshots <= t only; config selection per transition by mean J = PCC + P@200 up + down over the last 8 past transitions (all genes); fallback per-gene trend at i <= 1. Scores: random 25 % test genes per transition, 10 mask draws (seed 20261022), mean over transitions i >= 1; '| no_last' drops the last transition. Triples are [PCC, P@200 up, P@200 down].
